changes.details: Fixed the issue where only lowercase .ldr and .dat file extensions were recognized. Updated file extension handling throughout the application to be case-insensitive, now properly supporting both uppercase (.LDR, .DAT) and lowercase (.ldr, .dat) extensions. Improved part loading by normalizing file paths in the cache.

changes.description: Fixed synchronization between Monaco Editor and 3D viewer on startup
changes.details: Resolved an issue where the Monaco Editor would load a hardcoded default file while the 3D viewer loaded a different file. Modified the initialization sequence to ensure the Editor properly loads the same content as the 3D viewer. Added a fallback mechanism if the initial model fails to load.

changes.description: Implemented Monaco Editor integration for live LDraw code editing
changes.details: Added Monaco editor with LDraw syntax highlighting, file management capability, and live 3D scene updates. The editor now supports loading and saving models to/from the scenes folder. Added API endpoints for handling file operations. Any changes in the editor are immediately reflected in the 3D view via debounced model updates.

changes.description: Fixed LDraw coordinate system handling for proper part positioning
changes.details: Implemented proper handling of LDraw's coordinate system where -Y is up. Modified SceneManager to correctly invert Y coordinates when positioning parts, updating parts, and converting between Three.js and LDraw coordinate systems. This fixes the issue where parts at higher positions in LDraw files (more negative Y values) were appearing at lower positions in the 3D view.

changes.description: Added validation for LDraw file content to prevent HTML parsing errors
changes.details: Fixed an issue where HTML error pages (like 404 responses) were being parsed as LDraw files, causing parsing errors like 'Unknown line type "<!doctype"'. Added validation step to check if the content is actually an LDraw file before attempting to parse it, preventing invalid content from being cached.

changes.description: Fixed TransformControls error by removing dependency in InteractionController
changes.details: Resolved the 'THREE.Object3D.add: object not an instance of THREE.Object3D' error by removing the TransformManager dependency from InteractionController. Now the TransformControls are added directly to the scene in Canvas3D component, improving component separation and avoiding type casting issues with Three.js 0.175.0.

changes.description: Fixed Three.js import paths and TransformControls error
changes.details: Resolved the 'THREE.Object3D.add: object not an instance of THREE.Object3D. TransformControls' error by fixing inconsistent import paths. Changed import paths from 'three/addons/' to 'three/examples/jsm/' to match the actual file structure in Three.js 0.175.0. Updated how TransformControls is added to the scene in InteractionController to use proper type assertions.
